Name: Fish Editor for Content Patcher
Author: Kreestijan

[center][size=5][b]Fish Editor for Content Patcher[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
This is a standalone html editor for fishes, it allows you to edit pretty much everything about fishes, including pond data, aquarium data/sprites, locations etc. and then export them into a fully working Content Patcher pack ready to add to your game.
Currently only vanilla locations and items are built in, may add items/locations from SVE/RSV/ES in the future.

Just make your edits and then save fishes.json, that contains all data and you can open it back up whenever. When you're ready to export the pack just click "Write generated pack files" and point it to a folder, that's your mod.

[color=#ff7700][size=4]This is made purposefully to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45345]Double Size Sprite (DSS)[/url] so the canvas is 32x32 and it's made with that in mind, the output also assumed DSS is used.

If you want to modify it for vanilla 16x16 you are free to do so yourself, the source is available and free to use and modify.[/size][/color]

If you prefer using this directly without downloading it can be used here:  [url=https://kreestijan.github.io/StardewMods/]TOF Fish Editor[/url]
You can save/load your own fishes.json from your pc, have fun!
